newsitem.title: CHINA: China's Guangdong province shows 11 percent growth.
newsitem.headline: China's Guangdong province shows 11 percent growth.

text.p: The economy of China's booming southern province of Guangdong grew by more than 11 percent in 1996, outstripping the national rate of 9.7 percent, the Xinhua news agency said on Thursday.

Gross domestic product of the province totalled 610 billion yuan ($73 billion) in 1996, up by more than 11 percent compared with the previous year, it quoted provincial Communist Party secretary Xie Fei as saying.
Industrial output totalled about 1,000 billion yuan while exports hit $59 billion, Xie said.
The province curbed retail price inflation to 4.5 percent last year, against a national average of 6.1 percent, he said.
The number of people living in absolute poverty in Guangdong had been reduced to 600,000 from 800,000, he said.
